# NodeSight

When you track herbs or ore, the minimap just shows a dot for each one. You have to hover over every dot to see what it is. NodeSight puts the item's own picture on each dot so you don't have to.

## Features
* Red when your Herbalism or Mining is too low to gather it. Hover it and the tooltip says what it needs
* Gold sparkles on the herb or ore in front of you. Change the color, area, height and how many (off by default)
* Sparkles on chests, doors, quest objects and anything else you can interact with (off by default)
* Switches between Find Herbs and Find Minerals by itself as you move. You need both Herbalism and Mining (off by default).

## Download
* <https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/node-sight>

## NodeSight Sparkles
NodeSight's sparkles on their own, for Retail or if you only want the sparkles. Already using NodeSight? You don't need this. Its files are in the [NodeSightSparkles](https://github.com/Krelock/NodeSight/tree/main/NodeSightSparkles) folder.
